title: Modified RNeasy Mini Kit Protocol for Filter Extractions
author: Margaret M. Brisbin
materials: Make RLT+BME lysis buffer for the number of samples you have +1 in a fresh 15ml falcon tube: Per sample / extra: 690 µl of RLT buffer (RLT buffer is in the big red Qiagen box) 10 µl of BME (BME stays in the chemical hood) for 10 samples + 1 extra: 7590 µl RLT buffer (add this to tube first inside the RNA hood) 110 µl BME (add this to the tube inside the chem hood) vortex well to mix
Preheat the dry bath thermal block to 65ºC.
If following along with Qiagen protocol cards, switch over to Part 2 for on-column DNase digestion.

If following along with Qiagen Protocol cards, go back to part one and restart at step 5. Add 500 µl of Qiagen buffer RPE to the top of the spin column. Centrifuge at 100,00 rcf for 20s 10000 rcf, °C, 20 seconds
Discard entire collection tube and transfer spin columns to the fresh capless collection tubes (in zip-lock bag in the big red Qiagen box).

steps.title: Prepare RNA Hood and Workspace
steps.instruction: Decontaminate all surfaces inside the RNA hood using RNAase ZAP, RNAse AWAY, and 70% ethanol (etOH).

steps.title: Organize Required Tubes and Columns
steps.instruction: Set up the following materials in tube racks within the RNA hood for each sample:

substeps.instruction: 1x bead-bashing tube (from big red qiagen box)
2x RNeasy capped collection tubes (from big red qiagen box)
1x RNeasy filter column (pink, from big red qiagen box)
1x Lo-bind 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube

steps.title: Prepare Samples and Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare samples and necessary buffers for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Transfer filter tubes from -80°C freezer to liquid nitrogen dewar or dry ice cooler.
Prepare fresh 70% ethanol in a 15mL falcon tube using molecular grade ethanol and nuclease-free water (for 10 samples: 7000 µl ethanol and 3000 µl water). Vortex well.
Thaw DNase aliquots (100 µl each) by moving them from the freezer to the fridge.
Add 600 µl of RLT+BME lysis buffer to each bead-bashing tube and close tightly.

steps.title: Process Filter Samples
steps.instruction: Extract filter material into the lysis buffer using clean forceps and dissecting scissors (treated with RNAse-away before first use and etOH between samples).

substeps.instruction: Remove filter from cryovial and place over a petri-dish half (1 dish per 2 samples).
Cut filter into small pieces and transfer to the bead tube containing RLT+BME buffer.
Push filter pieces down to ensure all surfaces are submerged.
Label bead tubes and return remaining samples to dry ice or -80°C freezer.

steps.title: Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Incubate and mechanically disrupt the samples.

substeps.instruction: Incubate bead tubes in a thermal block dry bath at 65°C for 10 minutes.
Attach the bead tube adapter to the Vortex-Genie 2, ensuring the notch is aligned and clicked into place.
Vortex bead tubes at the highest speed setting for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge bead tubes for 1 minute at 4,000 rcf.

steps.title: Supernatant Recovery
steps.instruction: Collect the lysate from the bead tubes using a p1000 pipettor.

substeps.instruction: Remove all supernatant from the bead tube and transfer to a labeled RNeasy capped collection tube.
Wring-out the filter by pressing it against the tube wall and push the tip into the beads to collect remaining liquid.
Centrifuge the collection tubes for 1 minute at 4,000 rcf.
Transfer 450 µl of the supernatant to a new, clean RNeasy capped collection tube.

steps.title: RNA Binding and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to the spin columns and perform initial washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 450 µl of fresh 70% EtOH to the sample and mix gently by pipette.
Transfer 450 µl of the mixture to the top of a labeled pink spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 rcf for 20 seconds and discard the flowthrough.
Transfer the remaining 450 µl of sample/ethanol to the spin column and centrifuge again at 10,000 rcf for 20 seconds; discard flowthrough.
Add 350 µl of Qiagen buffer RW1 to each column and centrifuge at 10,000 rcf for 20 seconds; discard flowthrough.

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination from the bound RNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare DNase master mix by adding 700 µl of RDD buffer to 100 µl of thawed DNase aliquot; mix and quick spin.
Add 80 µl of DNase master mix directly to the center of each spin column membrane (do not touch the membrane).
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Add 350 µl of Qiagen buffer RW1 to each column and centrifuge at 10,000 rcf for 20 seconds; discard flowthrough.

steps.title: Final Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the columns and elute the purified RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µl of Qiagen buffer RPE to the spin column and centrifuge at 10,000 rcf for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge again at maximum speed (21,300 rcf) for 1 minute.
Transfer the spin column to a labeled 1.5 mL lo-bind Eppendorf tube.
Add 30 µl of RNase-free water to the center of the membrane and centrifuge at 10,000 rcf for 1 minute.
Pipette the 30 µl eluate back onto the center of the membrane and centrifuge again at 10,000 rcf for 1 minute.

steps.title: Quantification and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Quantify and analyze the extracted RNA.

substeps.instruction: Perform RNA HS Qubit assay using 1 µl of sample and 199 µl of qubit reagent.
Perform Pico RNA 6000 Bioanalyzer assay, diluting all samples to 5 ng/µl.

steps.title: Cleanup and Storage
steps.instruction: Store samples and decommission the workspace.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 1 µl of successful samples into PCR tubes and store in the -80°C freezer in a labeled box.
Store remaining sample tubes in the project box in the -80°C freezer.
Dispose of BME garbage in a tied garbage bag.
Wipe the RNA hood and surrounding surfaces with 70% etOH.
Run the UV light in the hood for 15 minutes after ensuring no biological samples or reagents remain.
Turn off the centrifuge and heating block.
